intro: Mor'rogal asks you to bring him the glittering sunstones collected by Bloodfury harpies in the Charred Vale. He says the stones hold a connection to the lights of the skies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.
While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have important matters to consider, adventurer. Be quick.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have brought sunstones that the harpies collect! The harpies love to gather objects that are shiny, but they do not know the true value of the stones. By capturing the dazzling light of the sun, these stones reflect its majesty and allow us to adorn our shrines and homes with tiny motes of light in its honor. The moon, too, illuminates them with its silver beauty at night.
These stones remind us of the connection we have to the lights of the skies.
